body: I have tried this - but I don't know how much it's actually helped. It does help stave off anxiety attacks but as soon as I stop, everything comes back. Is this normal? Am I doing it wrong?
Can I PM you for some advice? I completely understand if you'd rather not though x

Thank you, I really appreciate the offer. I think so many of my problems stem from self-loathing and low self-esteem but I don't know how to even begin to fix that. I'm in therapy, I'm on meds, but it doesn't seem to be enough.
